title: NALIRIFOX-RWE 2Y – A multicentre, retrospective registry study investigating the first two years of nalirifox use in everyday clinical practice for ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreas following marketing authorisation
summary:
The data used in this project are derived from existing clinical treatment records or an existing oncology registry at the participating institutions, in which care data for patients with ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreas are routinely recorded.
This data collection had already taken place as part of routine clinical care, independently of the scientific research question at hand.

interventions.name:
Primary objective
To investigate survival endpoints in patients with ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreas who were treated with nalirifox in everyday clinical practice.

Secondary objectives
•    To describe treatment patterns and dose adjustments

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- histologically or cytologically confirmed ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreas
- Treatment with Nalirifox in routine clinical practice between 3 May 2024 and 2 May 2026
- at least one documented administration of liposomal irinotecan as part of Nalirifox therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- Histology not consistent with ductal adenocarcinoma of the pancreas
- No actual treatment with nalirifox or administration of liposomal irinotecan
